thought.text: The `prepare` script (husky) failed, but lockfile-only may have been written. Let me verify:

reasoning_content: The `prepare` script runs `husky`, but it's not installed during the lockfile-only pass. Let me check if package-lock.json got written despite the error, and whether it's in sync:

action.command: cd /workspace/01-frontend && ls -la package-lock.json && node:20 2>/dev/null; docker run --rm -v /workspace/01-frontend:/w -w /w node:20-bookworm sh -c "node -e \"const l=require('/w/package-lock.json'); const k=Object.keys(l.packages).filter(x=>x.includes('openapi-ts')).map(x=>x+' '+l.packages[x].version); console.log(k);\"; npm ls @hey-api/openapi-ts xlsx c12 2>&1 | tail -20"
